title: New Benefit for Ohio NFIB Members: Sedgwick Group Health Program
text:
February 13, 2026
Take Control of Rising Healthcare Costs
NFIB and Sedgwick are proud to announce a new and trusted solutions for NFIB members: Sedgwick’s Group Health Program powered by ClearPoint Health. The program delivers real-time insights and proactive cost management, so you’ll finally understand what you’re paying for and why.
This new benefit ensures your business has access to a program designed to protect your bottom line and give you confidence in your healthcare strategy.
Learn more about the program here!
Rising Health Costs at a Glance:
- Employer health benefit costs are projected to rise by 5% in 2026.
- Employer-sponsored health plans now cost an average of $17,496 per employee.
- Prescription drug costs jumped by 4%, becoming one of the biggest cost drivers.
- Family premiums are nearing $27,000 annually, putting pressure on budgets.
NFIB is a member-driven organization advocating on behalf of small and independent businesses nationwide.
